value.rationale: The digit-count asymptotic variance is a natural dynamical observable not determined by its average. The exact sharp bias envelope shows a unique noise-maximizing fair-choice point, 5.295-fold amplification versus deterministic choices, and deviation from an i.i.d. fair-digit law of the same mean. It distinguishes the stationary absolutely continuous law from the maximal-entropy law and isolates the probabilistic mechanism (marked renewal rewards) even though switch timing is bias-independent.
